lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrZn₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 16-atom unit cell (Sr₄Zn₁₂) and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Sr and Zn centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom, spanning distances of about 3.03–3.58 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Zn and Sr coordination polyhedra.
